# Srutam — Private AI Voice Notes App (Android)

> Private on-device AI voice notes: offline transcription, summaries, tasks, conversational chat over notes, BYOK + MCP server. Zero audio uploads for basic transcription.

## Core pages
- Home: https://srutam.iamjustkrishna.app/ — capture → understand → act; features; privacy; audiences; FAQ; download
- Google Play: https://play.google.com/store/apps/details?id=space.iamjustkrishna.srutam

## What Srutam does
- On-device speech recognition; audio stays on the phone
- AI insights: Next Steps, Ideas, Decisions; summary + key points + WIIFM
- Conversational AI chat across recordings with cited source notes
- Actionable task checklists + smart reminders from voice
- Floating record dock, cosmic dark mode, local Room database + privacy lock
- BYOK (bring your own AI key) + MCP server for coding workflows

## Who it is for
- Founders & creators capturing ideas while walking
- Engineers recording architecture decisions and standups
- Students turning lectures into revision notes
- Professionals converting meetings into action items
- ADHD brain dumpers who want structure without organizing first

## FAQ (abridged — full answers on site + llms-full.txt)
- Is Srutam private? Yes — local transcription + storage, opt-in sync.
- Does it work offline? Capture + transcription yes; BYOK AI features need internet.
- Does the website demo use my microphone? No. It uses a prepared sample without recording or uploading.
- How do voice memos become tasks? Optional connected AI extracts Next Steps for checklists and reminders.
